title: Tuy Hoa in a day
summary: A day on the Độc Lập beach, bánh canh hẹ at chợ Tuy Hòa, then the tower and the river. The afternoon can go north to the stone plates or south to Bãi Môn–Mũi Đại Lãnh. Come back to Độc Lập or to Quảng trường 1/4, and on Saturday the tower-yard show is at 19:30.

stops.name: Tuy Hoa beach
stops.note: Start with a swim or a walk on the city sand along Độc Lập.

stops.name: Banh canh he
stops.note: Have bánh canh hẹ at chợ Tuy Hòa, where it is sold all day.

stops.name: Nhan Tower
stops.note: Give the middle of the day to the brick tower on the north bank, and on Saturday the yard show is at 19:30.

stops.name: Da Rang
stops.note: Walk the river under the hill.

additions.name: So huyet o loan
additions.note: Đầm Ô Loan is 25 km north if the afternoon leaves the city for the blood cockles.

seoTitle: Tuy Hoa in a day — beach, tower, and the river
seoDescription: One day in Tuy Hoa: the Độc Lập beach, bánh canh hẹ, Tháp Nhạn, and the Đà Rằng. The Saturday tower-yard show is at 19:30.
